description: The pie chart represents the distribution of matches across different categories. The chart is divided into seven slices, each labeled with a number ranging from 0 to 6. The slices are colored in various shades of blue, yellow, and green. The largest slice, labeled "6 Matches" and colored light blue, accounts for approximately 27.2% (8006) of the total. The second-largest slice, labeled "2" and colored pale green, represents 22.4% (6583). The remaining slices are labeled "1" (13.8%, 4046, yellow), "0" (13.3%, 3910, beige), "5" (10.4%, 3043, blue), "3" (6.8%, 2002, light green), and "4" (6.2%, 1810, pale blue-green). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice at the top. No legend is present, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
